entries.name: mcp
entries.reason: reports mcp_requests_total{outcome}, mcp_tool_calls_total{tool,outcome}, mcp_auth_failures_total{reason}, mcp_tool_call_duration_seconds{tool}, mcp_key_fetches_total{outcome} and mcp_issuer_up (the IssuerProbe, once a minute), one McpToolCall log line per tool call and an mcp.tool <name> span; a new assistant grant is an audit row and an assistant_grant.created event

entries.name: web-e2e
entries.reason: test project, not deployed

entries.name: keycloak
entries.reason: staging only; health at /realms/master, answering once the realm is imported; the MCP server's mcp_issuer_up probe is the only signal (Keycloak itself sends no telemetry)

entries.name: mcp
entries.reason: staging only; health at /health/live; mcp_issuer_up is its liveness series

entries.name: insights
entries.reason: three nightly jobs, platform-daily, response-stats and profile-views, counted by motorfix_jobs_total{job_name,outcome} and logged once on their final failure; a missed night of the first two leaves the last figures in place and the next night recounts; profile-views has its own final-failure alert, since its counters expire two days after their day

entries.name: verification-result
entries.reason: counted by motorfix_verification_result_total (built, skipped) on motorfix-queues; one VerificationResult log line per event with the file id, the decision and the owners told; the job runs in the worker's queue span; BullMQ's queue metrics cover depth, and the alert fires on a job's final failure

entries.name: quote-received
entries.reason: counted by motorfix_quote_received_total (built, muted) on motorfix-queues and motorfix-product; BullMQ's queue metrics cover depth and failures

entries.name: quote-timers
entries.reason: carries the relay's request.declined events and each decline's undo-window timer and sweep; counted by motorfix_decline_windows_closed_total (sent, muted, skipped_undone, skipped_closed, already_told, by timer or sweep) with one DeclineWindow log line per window naming the recipient id; BullMQ's queue metrics cover depth and failures; decline-window-sweep-late fires when the sweep closes more than 10 windows in an hour (lost timers)

entries.name: brevo
entries.reason: carries e-mail and the WhatsApp sign-in and phone-change codes (ST-139: sent straight from the API, a failure logs 'phone code not sent: whatsapp_failed (<kind>)' and counts on the request-duration metric as the sign-in's 502 or the phone change's 503 send_failed, which api-error-rate covers); worker-jobs-failed and worker-saturation cover the worker's e-mail sends

entries.name: geoapify
entries.reason: reports motorfix_places_lookups_total{provider,outcome} and motorfix_places_provider_duration_seconds{provider}

entries.name: openfreemap
entries.reason: map tiles fetched by the browser, no key; a failed load shows the map-down message and is not counted server-side

entries.name: motorfix_maintenance_refusals_total
entries.reason: counts calls refused while maintenance is on, by route and role (visitor or signed_in); ST-879 adds the dashboard; a count has no failure to alert on; the api-error-rate rule covers the service that reports it

entries.name: motorfix_platform_rule_changes_total
entries.reason: counts rule change requests by action (requested, approved, refused, cancelled), with one PlatformRuleChanges log line per step; a count has no failure to alert on; the api-error-rate rule covers the service that reports it

entries.name: grafana-faro
entries.reason: the browser's collector

entries.name: keycloak
entries.reason: the identity server signing-key fetch, host read from ASSISTANT_ISSUER; counted in mcp_key_fetches_total{outcome} on the mcp dashboard; a failed fetch fires mcp-key-fetch-failures, and calls answer 503 (not counted as sign-in failures); the IssuerProbe reads its discovery document once a minute into mcp_issuer_up, which fires mcp-issuer-unreachable

entries.name: plausible
entries.reason: only the visitor's browser calls it, and only after a valid Accept; nothing on the server waits on it, Plausible's own site shows the page views, and the consent choices it rests on are counted on motorfix-product (motorfix_consent_records_total)

entries.name: mcp_tool_calls_total{tool=~"list_quote_requests|get_schedule|get_day_sheet|get_stats|decline_quote_request"}
entries.reason: the four garage read tools count under mcp_tool_calls_total{tool,outcome} and mcp_tool_call_duration_seconds{tool}, one McpToolCall log line and an mcp.tool <name> span per call, like every tool; the existing mcp-tool-errors alert sums every tool; reads write no audit row; decline_quote_request (ST-345) acts, so its decline writes the audit row marked via the assistant and counts in motorfix_request_declines_total

entries.name: motorfix_garage_profile_cache_total
entries.reason: counts the public profile cache by outcome (hit, miss, drop); a count has no failure to alert on; the api-error-rate rule covers the service that reports it

entries.name: motorfix_quote_requests_sent_total
entries.reason: counts quote requests sent by outcome (sent with its recipients, cannot_receive, limit, invalid — invalid counts the use case's own refusals, not the validation pipe's or a missing Idempotency-Key), with one log line per send naming the outcome and the request id; a count has no failure to alert on; the api-error-rate rule covers the service that reports it

entries.name: motorfix_request_received_total
entries.reason: counts each garage a new request reaches by outcome (built, muted, skipped), with one log line per event naming the request id and how many staff it reached; a count has no failure to alert on; the worker-jobs-failed rule covers the service that reports it

entries.name: motorfix_quotes_sent_total
entries.reason: counts quotes garages send by outcome (sent, refused, already_answered, request_not_open; refused covers the service's own 400, 403 and 404, the validation pipe's 400s show in the route metric) and records motorfix_quote_response_minutes (request created to quote sent) with no identifiers, with one Quotes log line per send naming the quote id, the request id and the outcome; a count has no failure to alert on; the api-error-rate rule covers the service that reports it

entries.name: motorfix_request_declines_total
entries.reason: counts garage declines by outcome (declined, already_answered, request_not_open, invalid; invalid counts the service's own 403 and 404, the validation pipe's 400s show in the route metric) and reason code, with no identifiers, and one Declines log line per decline naming the recipient and request ids; the route is POST /api/v1/garage/requests/{id}/decline in http.server.request.duration; a count has no failure to alert on; the api-error-rate rule covers the service that reports it

entries.name: motorfix_decline_windows_closed_total
entries.reason: counts each closed decline undo window by outcome and whether the timer or the sweep closed it; a rising sweep share means lost timers; a count has no failure to alert on; the api-error-rate rule covers the service that reports it

entries.name: motorfix_verification_result_total
entries.reason: counts each verification decision told to its garage's owners by outcome (built, skipped: no owner or no decision to tell), with the fan-out's log line naming the file id; also on motorfix-product; a count has no failure to alert on, the verification-result queue entry owns the final-failure alert

entries.name: motorfix_quote_received_total
entries.reason: counts each sent quote announced to its driver by outcome (built, muted), with the fan-out's log line naming the quote id; also on motorfix-product; a count has no failure to alert on; the worker-jobs-failed rule covers the service that reports it

entries.name: quotes
entries.reason: one log line per send naming the quote id, the request id and the outcome; the send counter and response-time histogram are the motorfix_quotes_sent_total entry

entries.name: motorfix_searches_total
entries.reason: a count has no failure to alert on; the api-error-rate rule covers the service that reports it

entries.name: motorfix_sign_ins_total
entries.reason: a count has no failure to alert on; the api-error-rate rule covers the service that reports it

entries.name: motorfix_garage_sign_ups_total
entries.reason: a count has no failure to alert on; the api-error-rate rule covers the service that reports it

entries.name: motorfix_garage_approvals_total
entries.reason: a count has no failure to alert on; the api-error-rate rule covers the service that reports it

entries.name: motorfix_quotes_total
entries.reason: a count has no failure to alert on; the api-error-rate rule covers the service that reports it

entries.name: motorfix_emails_sent_total
entries.reason: a count has no failure to alert on; the worker-jobs-failed rule covers the service that reports it

entries.name: motorfix_notifications_sent_total
entries.reason: a count has no failure to alert on; the worker-jobs-failed rule covers the service that reports it

entries.name: garage-job-steps
entries.reason: each refusal logs one 'job step refused' line with ids and its code

entries.name: motorfix_job_steps_total
entries.reason: counts step changes by action (added, renamed, reordered, removed, ticked, unticked); a count has no failure to alert on; the api-error-rate rule covers the service that reports it

entries.name: motorfix_account_changes_total
entries.reason: counts saved changes of an account's own details by field (name, city, email, phone, password); a change count has no failure mode of its own

entries.name: my-details
entries.metric: http.server.request.duration by http.route PATCH /api/v1/me, POST /api/v1/me/email, /api/v1/me/phone, /api/v1/me/phone/confirm and /api/v1/auth/confirm-email (the change link)
entries.reason: each refusal logs one 'phone change refused: <code>' or 'e-mail change link not sent' line, never the address or number; the WhatsApp code goes out through the brevo entry and a failed send logs 'phone code not sent: whatsapp_failed (<kind>)' and answers 503 send_failed; saved changes are motorfix_account_changes_total; spans come from the HTTP and Prisma auto-instrumentation

entries.name: auth-password
entries.reason: each refusal logs one 'password change refused: <code>' line and a failed notice e-mail logs 'password changed e-mail not sent'; a saved change counts on motorfix_account_changes_total{field="password"}

entries.name: garage-reports
entries.reason: refusals show on the request-duration metric by route and status code

entries.name: motorfix_garage_reports_total
entries.reason: outcomes created, already_reported and refused (both 409); 404 and 429 read from the request-duration metric by route and status; a count has no failure to alert on; the api-error-rate rule covers the service that reports it

entries.name: listing-documents
entries.reason: a page left in storage after a failed delete logs one warning with the draft id and key

entries.name: admin-verification-documents
entries.reason: each issued address writes one open entry in the history and counts motorfix_documents_opened_total

entries.name: motorfix_documents_uploaded_total
entries.reason: counts each confirmed document page by kind (onrc_certificate, rar_authorisation); a count has no failure to alert on; the api-error-rate rule covers the service that reports it

entries.name: motorfix_declarations_signed_total
entries.reason: counts each signed declaration; a count has no failure to alert on; the api-error-rate rule covers the service that reports it

entries.name: motorfix_documents_opened_total
entries.reason: counts each time an admin opens a document page, by kind; a count has no failure to alert on; the api-error-rate rule covers the service that reports it

entries.name: profile-views
entries.reason: the public profile's beacon; every outcome is the motorfix_profile_views_total entry, which owns the lost-view alert; the api-error-rate rule covers its 5xx

entries.name: motorfix_profile_views_total
entries.reason: counts each beacon by outcome (accepted, bot, staff, no_key, lost, throttled, not_found) with no garage, address or visitor label; a lost view logs one ProfileViews error line naming the Redis error only

entries.name: motorfix_profile_view_rows_total
entries.reason: counts the daily rows the night writes and the days it logs as gaps, with one ProfileViews log line per day naming the day and the count; a failed night is the profile-views-job-failed alert

entries.name: motorfix_consent_records_total
entries.reason: counts each analytics consent choice stored, by decision; a choice count has no failure mode of its own; the consents endpoint carries the api error-rate and latency rules

entries.name: outage-alerts
entries.reason: Grafana's outage contact point calls it; one Outage log line per alert (service, state, fingerprint, admins, sent), never the token or an address; the uptime checks (infra/observability/uptime/checks.json) and the outage rule watch the services it reports on
